title: Adjunction conjugation preserves coefficient squares
statement: Let A,B,C,D be categories; let P ⊣ Q and P' ⊣ Q' be adjunctions between A and B, and F ⊣ G and F' ⊣ G' adjunctions between C and D. Fix coefficient functors R:A→C and T:B→D and natural transformations χ:R⋙F→P⋙T, χ':R⋙F'→P'⋙T. For α:P'→P and β:F'→F, assume the two whiskered squares χ⋅β and χ'⋅α agree. Then for every X:B, mate(χ)_X followed by conjugate(β)_(T X) equals R(conjugate(α)_X) followed by mate(χ')_X. All mates and conjugates use the indicated adjunctions.

source.place: The maps used here are tensor reassociation, evaluation, and adjunction units and counits, whose coefficient comparisons are proved in lem-fix-operation-reduction; coherence inherited from individual maps.

proof.text: Apply mateEquiv for P ⊣ Q and F' ⊣ G' to the equality of whiskered squares. Mathlib mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv_vcomp and conjugateEquiv_mateEquiv_vcomp identify its sides with the bottom and top whiskerings by the conjugate transformations. Evaluate at X and simplify associator and identity components.

proof_origin.place: Coefficient coherence for adjunction transposition, proved using the Mathlib vertical composition identities.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryProperOpenConjugateSquare
    {A B C D : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] [Category C] [Category D]
    {P P' : A ⥤ B} {Q Q' : B ⥤ A} {F F' : C ⥤ D} {G G' : D ⥤ C}
    {R : A ⥤ C} {T : B ⥤ D}
    (a : P ⊣ Q) (a' : P' ⊣ Q') (b : F ⊣ G) (b' : F' ⊣ G')
    (χ : R ⋙ F ⟶ P ⋙ T) (χ' : R ⋙ F' ⟶ P' ⋙ T)
    (α : P' ⟶ P) (β : F' ⟶ F)
    (h : (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ χ).whiskerRight β =
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ χ').whiskerLeft α) (X : B) :
    (mateEquiv a b χ).natTrans.app X ≫
        (conjugateEquiv b b' β).app (T.obj X) =
      R.map ((conjugateEquiv a a' α).app X) ≫
        (mateEquiv a' b' χ').natTrans.app X
